title: RADAR TRACE attack-path profile
description: Deployment-independent attack-path intelligence for one CVE. Each attackPaths entry represents one materially distinct affected scope and exploit path. Trigger fields describe the immediate vulnerable-component boundary; requiredPathCapabilities describe the complete set of path capabilities a deployment must provide.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the core attack-path profile contract.

cveId.description: Uppercase CVE identifier classified by this profile.

attackPaths.description: Materially distinct exploit paths. Entries are alternatives; every attackerRequirements, requiredPathCapabilities, and preconditions entry within one path is required for that path.

evidence.description: Source-linked claims referenced by attack paths and preconditions.

notes.description: Optional profile-level explanation or residual uncertainty.

pathId.description: Stable identifier for this affected scope and exploit-path alternative.

protocols.description: Protocols or protocol layers evidenced on this path. This is a descriptive set, not a Boolean expression; encode a protocol that is strictly required as a protocol precondition. An empty array means no live protocol is required, not that the protocol is unknown.

attackerRequirements.description: Typed access, influence, or control requirements the attacker must satisfy. Every listed item is required; model alternatives as separate attackPaths. These are generic prerequisites, not deployment reachability claims.

requiredPathCapabilities.description: All end-to-end path capabilities required for this exploit-path alternative. Multiple values are conjunctive requirements.

preconditions.description: All configuration, state, feature, or execution conditions required for this path. Model alternatives as separate attackPaths entries.

notes.description: Optional path-specific explanation or residual uncertainty.

allOf.title: Local actor initiator requires local input
High confidence requires resolved material fields

description.description: Concise product/component scope for this path.

vendor.description: Affected vendor when established by evidence.

product.description: Affected product when established by evidence.

component.description: Affected component, backend, module, binary, or library.

routine.description: Affected function or routine when established by evidence.

packages.description: Affected package identities using CVE Record Format collectionURL and packageName, with an optional Package URL for deterministic SBOM joins.

cpes.description: Affected products represented by CPE 2.3 names when established by authoritative evidence.

versions.description: Machine-readable affected and unaffected version statements using CVE Record Format field names.

collectionURL.description: URL identifying the package collection, preserving the CVE Record Format meaning.

packageName.description: Package name or identifier within the named collection.

purl.description: Optional Package URL supplied by evidence or derived deterministically from the package identity.

versionStatus.description: Affected status using CVE Record Format values.

oneOf.title: Affected
oneOf.description: The product or version is affected.

oneOf.title: Unaffected
oneOf.description: The product or version is unaffected.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: The affected status is not established.

vulnerableRole.description: Role performed by the vulnerable component at the immediate trigger boundary.

oneOf.title: Listener
oneOf.description: Accepts a remotely initiated connection or request carrying the trigger.

oneOf.title: Client
oneOf.description: Initiates an outbound interaction and is triggered while sending or processing remote data.

oneOf.title: Peer
oneOf.description: Participates symmetrically in a protocol where either peer may initiate relevant traffic.

oneOf.title: Parser
oneOf.description: Parses a stored or file-like artifact outside a required live protocol exchange; the artifact may still have originated remotely.

oneOf.title: Local component
oneOf.description: Is invoked through an in-process API, IPC, local socket, agent, command, or other host-local boundary.

oneOf.title: Unknown role
oneOf.description: Available evidence does not establish the vulnerable component's role at the trigger boundary.

interactionInitiator.description: Party that initiates the connection or local action containing the immediate vulnerable-boundary trigger.

oneOf.title: Attacker-controlled component
oneOf.description: An attacker-controlled remote component initiates the interaction with the vulnerable component.

oneOf.title: Remote component
oneOf.description: A remote component not controlled by the attacker initiates the interaction; attacker control lies elsewhere, such as on the traffic path.

oneOf.title: Vulnerable component
oneOf.description: The vulnerable component initiates the network interaction in which the trigger occurs.

oneOf.title: Either peer
oneOf.description: Either participant in a symmetric peer relationship may initiate the triggering exchange.

oneOf.title: Upstream component
oneOf.description: A component between the original attacker and vulnerable component initiates or delivers the immediate interaction.

oneOf.title: Local process
oneOf.description: Another process on the same host initiates the local interaction.

oneOf.title: User
oneOf.description: A user action directly initiates processing of the triggering input or artifact.

oneOf.title: System
oneOf.description: A scheduler, queue consumer, background task, or operating-system action initiates processing.

oneOf.title: Unknown initiator
oneOf.description: Available evidence does not establish which party initiates the immediate interaction.

id.description: Canonical lowercase communication-protocol identifier, using an IANA name when available; `unknown` is reserved for unresolved protocols.

version.description: Optional protocol version when established by evidence.

protocolLayer.description: Communication layer at which the protocol operates. APIs and naming mechanisms such as JNDI are preconditions, not protocols.

oneOf.title: Application
oneOf.description: Application-layer communication protocol such as HTTP, LDAP, DNS, or RMI.

oneOf.title: Security
oneOf.description: Security or channel-protection protocol such as TLS.

oneOf.title: Transport
oneOf.description: Transport protocol such as TCP, UDP, SCTP, or QUIC.

oneOf.title: Network
oneOf.description: Network-layer protocol such as IP or ICMP.

oneOf.title: Local IPC
oneOf.description: Host-local communication mechanism such as a Unix-domain socket or named pipe.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: The available evidence does not establish the protocol layer.

trigger.description: Immediate event at the vulnerable component boundary. Later callbacks or delivery mechanisms belong in requiredPathCapabilities and attackerRequirements.

details.description: Optional concise description of the triggering operation or sequence.

triggerPhase.description: Processing phase in which vulnerable behavior is activated.

oneOf.title: Connection establishment
oneOf.description: The vulnerability is activated while establishing or negotiating a connection or session.

oneOf.title: Inbound request processing
oneOf.description: The vulnerable component processes a remotely initiated request.

oneOf.title: Remote response processing
oneOf.description: The vulnerable component processes data returned by a remote endpoint.

oneOf.title: Protocol message processing
oneOf.description: The vulnerable component processes a protocol message or frame not usefully modeled as a request or response.

oneOf.title: Outbound operation
oneOf.description: Vulnerable behavior occurs while constructing or sending an outbound operation.

oneOf.title: Scheduled processing
oneOf.description: A scheduler, queue, deferred task, or background worker activates vulnerable behavior after input was stored.

oneOf.title: File parsing
oneOf.description: Parsing a stored file or file-like artifact activates vulnerable behavior.

oneOf.title: Local invocation
oneOf.description: An in-process API, IPC, command, agent, or other local call activates vulnerable behavior.

oneOf.title: Unknown phase
oneOf.description: Available evidence establishes a path but not the processing phase.

triggerArtifact.description: Concrete data unit, object, or action processed at the immediate trigger boundary.

oneOf.title: Connection
oneOf.description: Connection setup state or parameters are the triggering artifact.

oneOf.title: Request
oneOf.description: A request or outbound request operation is the triggering artifact.

oneOf.title: Response
oneOf.description: A remote response is the triggering artifact.

oneOf.title: Redirect
oneOf.description: A redirect instruction or redirect-derived state is the triggering artifact.

oneOf.title: Handshake
oneOf.description: Protocol negotiation or handshake data is the triggering artifact.

oneOf.title: Message
oneOf.description: A protocol message is the triggering artifact.

oneOf.title: Frame
oneOf.description: A protocol frame, packet-level unit, or frame sequence is the triggering artifact.

oneOf.title: File
oneOf.description: A file, archive, document, media object, or other stored artifact is the trigger.

oneOf.title: API arguments
oneOf.description: Arguments passed through an application or library API are the trigger.

oneOf.title: Local input
oneOf.description: Host-local input outside a more specific API or file category is the trigger.

oneOf.title: Stored state
oneOf.description: Previously stored attacker-influenced state is processed later.

oneOf.title: No new artifact
oneOf.description: Activation does not require a new artifact to cross the vulnerable boundary.

oneOf.title: Unknown artifact
oneOf.description: Available evidence does not establish the concrete triggering artifact.

boundaryDirection.description: Direction in which the triggering artifact crosses the immediate vulnerable-component boundary.

oneOf.title: Remote to vulnerable
oneOf.description: The trigger moves from a remote component into the vulnerable component.

oneOf.title: Vulnerable to remote
oneOf.description: The vulnerable component emits the operation whose construction or transmission activates the behavior.

oneOf.title: Bidirectional
oneOf.description: Activation materially depends on state or data crossing the boundary in both directions.

oneOf.title: Local to vulnerable
oneOf.description: The trigger reaches the vulnerable component through an in-process or host-local boundary.

oneOf.title: No boundary crossing
oneOf.description: No new data crosses the boundary at activation, as with processing of previously stored state.

oneOf.title: Unknown direction
oneOf.description: Available evidence does not establish the triggering direction.

attackerRequirement.description: Typed access, influence, or control prerequisite the attacker must satisfy. Deployment-specific reachability is evaluated later.

oneOf.title: Endpoint control
oneOf.description: Control or influence of a remote endpoint or protocol peer.

oneOf.title: Network position
oneOf.description: Ability to observe or manipulate a traffic path.

oneOf.title: Input control
oneOf.description: Control or manipulation of an input object or response.

oneOf.title: Local access
oneOf.description: A user or process position on the vulnerable host.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: The category of attacker prerequisite is unresolved.

attackerRequirementValue.description: Specific attacker-controlled endpoint, object, position, or local actor.

oneOf.title: Remote client
oneOf.description: Attacker-controlled remote initiating endpoint.

oneOf.title: Remote endpoint
oneOf.description: Attacker-controlled destination contacted by the vulnerable component.

oneOf.title: Redirect target
oneOf.description: Attacker-controlled destination selected through redirect behavior.

oneOf.title: Proxy
oneOf.description: Attacker-controlled or influenced proxy.

oneOf.title: Network peer
oneOf.description: Attacker-controlled protocol peer.

oneOf.title: Traffic path
oneOf.description: On-path observation or manipulation position.

oneOf.title: Untrusted input
oneOf.description: Attacker-controlled input or value reaching vulnerable code.

oneOf.title: DNS response
oneOf.description: Attacker-controlled or manipulated DNS answer or state.

oneOf.title: Local user
oneOf.description: User identity or interactive position on the vulnerable host.

oneOf.title: Local process
oneOf.description: Same-host process, API caller, agent, or IPC participant.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: The specific attacker prerequisite is unresolved.

oneOf.title: Remote client
oneOf.description: The attacker controls a remote client that supplies input toward a vulnerable listener; no public-internet reachability is implied.

oneOf.title: Remote endpoint
oneOf.description: The attacker controls or influences a server or service contacted by the vulnerable component.

oneOf.title: Redirect target
oneOf.description: The attacker controls or influences a destination selected through redirect behavior.

oneOf.title: Proxy
oneOf.description: The attacker controls or influences a proxy used by the vulnerable component.

oneOf.title: Network peer
oneOf.description: The attacker controls or participates as a protocol peer in the relevant symmetric or federated exchange.

value.title: Traffic path
value.description: The attacker can observe, inject, replay, or modify traffic between otherwise distinct endpoints.

oneOf.title: Untrusted input
oneOf.description: The attacker controls an input, artifact, field, or value that reaches vulnerable code without implying host-local access.

oneOf.title: DNS response
oneOf.description: The attacker can control or manipulate the DNS answer or state relevant to the path; control of all DNS infrastructure is not implied.

oneOf.title: Local user
oneOf.description: The attacker requires a user identity or interactive context on the vulnerable host.

oneOf.title: Local process
oneOf.description: The attacker requires control of a same-host process, local API caller, agent, or IPC participant.

value.title: Unknown attacker requirement
value.description: Available evidence does not establish what access, influence, or control the attacker requires.

pathCapability.description: End-to-end path capability required for exploitation, independent of whether a deployment provides it.

oneOf.title: Remote-initiated ingress
oneOf.description: A remote component must be able to initiate and send an interaction toward the vulnerable listener, directly or through intermediaries; attacker control of that component is represented separately.

oneOf.title: Component-initiated egress
oneOf.description: The vulnerable component must initiate or continue an outbound interaction to an attacker-controlled or influenced control point.

oneOf.title: On-path interception
oneOf.description: The attacker must observe or manipulate traffic in transit.

oneOf.title: Peer network interaction
oneOf.description: The vulnerable component must exchange traffic with an attacker-controlled protocol peer.

oneOf.title: Local input transfer
oneOf.description: Attacker-influenced data must reach vulnerable code through a file, API, IPC, command, user action, logging, templating, or another local transfer. The original attacker need not be local.

oneOf.title: Unknown path capability
oneOf.description: Available evidence does not establish the required end-to-end path capability.

id.description: Stable path-local identifier for the condition.

description.description: Human-readable condition a consumer can resolve against product, configuration, or runtime evidence.

oneOf.title: Version
oneOf.description: Affected or fixed version condition.

oneOf.title: Configuration
oneOf.description: Required configuration setting or value.

oneOf.title: Build option
oneOf.description: Compile-time option or packaged feature.

oneOf.title: Runtime feature
oneOf.description: Feature or code path that must be active at runtime.

oneOf.title: Protocol
oneOf.description: Protocol, extension, or protocol behavior that must be enabled.

oneOf.title: Backend
oneOf.description: Required implementation backend or provider.

oneOf.title: Dependency
oneOf.description: Required dependent component, library, service, or module.

oneOf.title: API usage
oneOf.description: Required API, function, flag, or calling pattern.

oneOf.title: State
oneOf.description: Required data, session, cache, lifecycle, or other mutable state.

oneOf.title: Authentication
oneOf.description: Authentication mode, credential state, or privilege condition.

oneOf.title: Topology
oneOf.description: Generic placement or membership requirement intrinsic to the product path, such as participation in a cluster; actual deployment reachability is evaluated later.

oneOf.title: User action
oneOf.description: Required action by a user or operator.

oneOf.title: Other
oneOf.description: Material condition not represented by another kind.

confidence.description: Strength of evidence supporting this path as a whole.

oneOf.title: High confidence
oneOf.description: Authoritative or direct technical evidence establishes every material path field; high confidence cannot contain unknown taxonomy values.

oneOf.title: Medium confidence
oneOf.description: The path is well supported, but at least one material detail depends on a reasonable inference or incomplete evidence.

oneOf.title: Low confidence
oneOf.description: The path is provisional because evidence is sparse, ambiguous, indirect, or contradictory; publication must carry a review recommendation.

evidenceId.description: Stable identifier referenced from attack paths and preconditions.

sourceId.description: Identifier of a source present in the collected source record.

claim.description: Material attack-path claim supported by the source.

locator.description: Precise source location such as a CVE JSON path, advisory section, commit line, or template block.

pathRefs.description: Path IDs to which this claim applies, whether it supports or contradicts them.

evidenceSourceType.description: Kind of source containing the cited claim.

oneOf.title: CVE record
oneOf.description: CVE List V5 CNA or ADP record content.

oneOf.title: Vendor advisory
oneOf.description: Official affected-product vendor advisory.

oneOf.title: Upstream patch
oneOf.description: Upstream source patch, commit, or code review.

oneOf.title: Distribution advisory
oneOf.description: Operating-system or package-distribution advisory.

oneOf.title: VEX statement
oneOf.description: Vulnerability-exploitability exchange statement in CSAF, OpenVEX, CycloneDX, or another identified VEX format.

oneOf.title: OSV
oneOf.description: Official Open Source Vulnerabilities ecosystem record.

oneOf.title: GitHub Security Advisory
oneOf.description: GitHub Security Advisory record.

oneOf.title: Nuclei template
oneOf.description: Nuclei template used only as supporting evidence for its concrete test behavior.

oneOf.title: Other source
oneOf.description: Another explicitly identified source type.

evidenceStrength.description: Relationship between the source and cited claim.

oneOf.title: Explicit
oneOf.description: The source directly states or demonstrates the claim.

oneOf.title: Inferred
oneOf.description: The claim is a necessary or reasonable inference from the source.

oneOf.title: Corroborating
oneOf.description: The source supports a claim established more directly elsewhere.

oneOf.title: Contradictory
oneOf.description: The source materially conflicts with another cited path claim and requires review.
